versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: Add 5 random monsters with +2/+2 at the end of your deck when the game begins.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of turns 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15, add a random monster to your deck.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of the game, add 5 random monsters with +2/+2 to the bottom of your deck.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of your 7th turn, Shuffle 3 Drafts into your deck and add one to your hand.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of every 10th turn, add 4 Drafts to your hand and send any that didn't fit to your deck. At the end of every 10th turn, give all monsters in your hand +1/+2.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of every 10th turn, add 3 Drafts to your hand and send any that didn't fit to your deck. At the end of every 10th turn, give all monsters in your hand +1/+1.

versions.name: Reinforcement
versions.text: At the start of every 10th turn, add 4 Drafts to your hand. At the end of every 10th turn, give all monsters in your hand +1/+1.
